display.clozeText: Romantic charm or flirt-game, especially the kind people joke about online (Kai Cenat / streamer slang)
Smooth romantic charm that works without obvious effort or even much talking (rizz discourse)
Unrealistically hopeful or proudly self-delusional about love, success, or your chances (K-pop / TikTok slang)
Joking idea that being delusional is somehow the answer to your problems (TikTok / delulu meme)
Acting like life is your movie and everyone else is supporting cast (TikTok self-narration)
The deep backstory behind a person, situation, or bit of drama (fandom / gaming talk)
A random extra mission, detour, or weird little activity that is not the main point (gaming slang)
Someone acting robotic, generic, repetitive, or like they are running default dialogue (gaming / livestream slang)
A point in your life defined by a theme or aesthetic, often announced dramatically online (TikTok self-branding)
A soft "this has that vibe" label attached to a person, thing, or mood, like saying something feels a certain way (TikTok descriptor style)
A themed aesthetic category built by attaching "-core" to it, like cottagecore or weird little officecore (TikTok aesthetics)
A phrase for internet-fed mental mush or for the content causing it, especially in 2024 and after (Oxford 2024 / online culture)
Browsing so much low-value bad-news or addictive content that your mood gets wrecked (pandemic and post-pandemic internet life)
Being embarrassingly or intensely shaped by the internet in how you think or talk (internet discourse)
Same basic idea, but with more emphasis on being too absorbed in online life to function normally (internet discourse)
A rude way to tell someone to log off, go outside, and reconnect with reality (internet comeback)
Lying in bed for ages scrolling, watching, and lowkey decomposing on purpose (TikTok wellness / burnout slang)
Unapologetically gross, lazy, shameless, or feral in a way that rejects normal expectations (Oxford 2022)
Phrase used when someone's idea sounds chaotic now but might actually turn out genius if allowed to continue (meme slang)
Being in trouble, beyond saving, mentally fried, or socially done for (internet meme slang)
The opposite mood, where things suddenly seem hopeful again after disaster (meme mood swing language)
The doom version, where the speaker acts like the entire future has collapsed (meme mood swing language)
Intensely focused, dialed in, and serious about the task in front of you (sports / gaming / internet slang)
The feeling that someone's social coolness can be imagined as points they gain or lose (TikTok teen slang)
A hard-to-define cool factor, vibe power, or social charisma that people talk about as if it were measurable (TikTok teen slang)
Trying too obviously to look cool, impressive, or effortlessly iconic, which defeats the point (TikTok teen slang)
A dismissive way younger people use "uncle" for an older guy who seems old, corny, or out of touch (2025 youth slang)
A snappy way to say "you still are not understanding what I'm saying" (viral 2025 phrase)
Phrase used when someone does something mostly for chaos, attention, or narrative entertainment (TikTok / meme talk)
A moment people describe as inevitable character-building, often in dating or family drama (TikTok / fandom-ish meme talk)
Extremely mediocre, overhyped, or just not impressive enough to justify the hype (internet rating slang)
Looking rough, busted, or unattractive in a blunt, often mean online way (current online appearance slang)
Outclassing someone hard in looks, presence, or status (looks / manosphere / meme slang)
Trying to optimize your attractiveness with routines, appearance tweaks, or pseudo-biohacking (looksmax internet culture)
The jaw/posture face exercise trend younger internet users turned into a meme and self-improvement ritual (TikTok / looksmax culture)
A complaint that someone is praising, hyping, or defending another person way too hard (current online insult)
A ruder, more vulgar version of "glazing," meaning excessive, shameless admiration (online insult slang)
An undefined pre-dating zone where two people are involved but nothing is official (Oxford 2023 shortlist / dating slang)
The stage before official dating when two people are flirting, texting, and testing the waters (TikTok dating slang)
A secret hookup or person you meet privately and quietly (TikTok / texting slang)
A subtle first reveal of a relationship, often just enough for followers to notice (Instagram / TikTok dating culture)
The full obvious reveal of a relationship once you stop being subtle about it (Instagram / TikTok dating culture)
A photo or post designed to get sexual or romantic attention without saying that directly (Instagram / TikTok culture)
A person who gives absurdly eager romantic attention or devotion, usually in a way people clown on (streaming / meme slang)
That tiny behavior or trait that suddenly kills attraction for somebody, often irrationally (TikTok dating discourse)
Something mildly odd about a person that is not a red flag, but not exactly a selling point either (TikTok dating discourse)
Someone seen as performing helplessness, specialness, or "not like other girls" energy for attention (internet gender discourse)
A confident, hyper-polished, very online attractive-girl persona or look (Instagram / TikTok beauty culture)
Phrase for when someone is speaking with full seriousness and zero irony about something ridiculous (TikTok comeback)
Same phrase as texting shorthand, often used to call out nonsense in five letters (text / TikTok shorthand)
A framing phrase used before naming a vibe, mood, or quality something is giving off (current TikTok syntax)
Used after someone absolutely nailed a look, performance, or line and did not leave anything for others to add (stan / TikTok phrase)
Phrase for the person or thought you keep revisiting weirdly often, especially when everyone online starts realizing they do too (viral social prompt)
A joking explanation for irrational female-coded consumer logic or arithmetic (viral 2023 meme)
A minimal, random, snacky, or aesthetically unserious meal that people online jokingly framed as a feminine meal type (viral 2023 meme)
Same meme structure as girl math, but for ridiculous male-coded logic or excuses (viral response meme)
A hyper-online way of saying someone's words are nonsense, repetitive, or unserious chatter (internet insult)
Calling something emotionally overwhelming, deeply embarrassing, or so intense it makes you react physically and dramatically (TikTok reaction slang)
Saying you are mentally elsewhere, blank, or disconnected in a stylized meme way (reaction meme language)
Saying a thing has become your whole personality, current obsession, or repeating fixation (TikTok / stan-ish phrasing)
Internet nonsense word that became a youth-culture signal of absurdity more than a stable meaning, though it leans younger than core Gen Z (Skibidi Toilet / late 2023 onward)
A slang term from streamer culture about taking some of someone else's food as a joke "tax," also later used ironically as nonsense slang (Fanum / AMP)
Exaggerated slang for butt or curves that spread explosively through late-Gen-Z and Gen-Alpha meme speech (viral meme song ecosystem)
A term for trying to go all-out or commit fully, sometimes used by kids for reckless hype behavior more than serious effort (2025 youth slang)
Current nonsense-number meme phrase used performatively rather than for clear semantic meaning, especially by younger users in 2025 (2025 viral slang)
A phrase describing internet anger-bait designed to provoke outrage and engagement, especially visible by 2025 (Oxford 2025)
A recent way to say something is not hitting, not landing, or not registering with the listener (viral phrase drift)
Someone being "for the bit" so hard that the original meaning barely matters anymore and the performance itself is the joke (meme performance culture)
A chaotic internet phrase for deliberately making yourself part of the joke, often by leaning into cringe (meme self-awareness)
A term for being overly invested in maintaining a social image that looks effortless but is actually carefully curated (aura discourse)
